description: Two stakeholders are named, then 'he' signs, with no way to tell which; the approved budget was replaced by an unstated figure; a month/day meeting.

turns.text: How did the proposal land internally?
Kofi and Samir both went through it last week. He's the one who signs, though, so he'll want the redlines.
We had eighty approved, but finance replaced that with a new envelope last week, and I don't have the new number yet.
Good. When can we walk through redlines?

evidence.quote: We had eighty approved, but finance replaced that with a new envelope last week

budget.rationale: 80K was approved but has been explicitly replaced by a newer figure the customer can't state → SUPERSEDED; the replacement isn't representable, so nothing can be written.

decisionMaker.rationale: Final authority is stated, but 'He' could be Kofi or Samir and nothing resolves it. The signer isn't identifiable, so no representable value → ABSTAIN (v1.3 §2.2, §3.4). Choosing either person, or both, would invent identity information.

nextMeeting.rationale: Customer proposes an explicit month/day and time; the rep accepts.
